# ScribeGulf

> Academic writing support for UAE university students. ScribeGulf produces well-structured, properly referenced model answers and academic reference material across undergraduate, MBA, CIPD Level 5 and 7, and dissertation level. Every brief is matched to a subject-expert writer and reviewed against the student's rubric before delivery. Grounded in 25 years of education sector experience.

## About

- ScribeGulf serves university students studying in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), including at Heriot-Watt University Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, the American University of Sharjah, Zayed University, HCT, and UAEU.
- The service delivers model answers and academic reference material intended to support a student's own learning and writing. It is not a ghostwriting service, and it does not guarantee grades.
- Contact: info@scribegulf.com · Instagram @scribe_gulf · Working hours Sunday–Thursday, 9am–8pm UAE time.

## Key facts

- Services: college and diploma, undergraduate assignments, Masters and MBA, CIPD Level 5 and 7, dissertation and thesis, editing and proofreading.
- Pricing: from AED 35 per page (one page = 250–275 words). College AED 35–45, undergraduate AED 45–55, Masters/MBA AED 55–65, CIPD AED 60–75, dissertation AED 65–80, editing/proofreading AED 15–25.
- Delivery: 48–72 hours standard; 24-hour urgent delivery available for an additional fee.
- Quality: every order is matched to a subject-expert writer, reviewed against the rubric, and plagiarism-checked targeting below 5% similarity on Copyscape.
- Experience: 25 years in the education sector.
